title: Edge component of an occurrence lies in the edge multiset
statement: Let $G$ be a multigraph, and let its graph-only occurrence space be the finite set of edge occurrences of $G$, whose elements are pairs $(e, k)$ consisting of an edge $e$ together with an index $k$ distinguishing the copies of $e$ among the parallel edges of $G$. Then for every occurrence $(e, k)$ in this space, the edge $e$ belongs to the edge multiset of $G$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a multigraph on a vertex type with decidable equality
$(e,k)$ is an element of the graph-only occurrence space of $G$ (i.e. an occurrence in the enumeration of the edge multiset)
replaced:
The first projection of any element of the graph-only occurrence space of $G$ is an edge
of $G$.
